hypotheses.justification: The current proof uses this only through exists_basis_range_ordProj (to show the range of ordProj is generated by a basis vector). Replacement argument: let P = ordProj φ α β and M = range P. (1) M ≤ A∙w by hw, as in the existing proof. (2) P is idempotent by isIdempotentElem_ordProj hφ hu, which needs only Free, Finite, hφ and hu. (3) trace P = 1: the computation in exists_basis_range_ordProj, using only LinearMap.charpoly_sub_smul and hφ, gives (φ - algebraMap β).charpoly = (X - C(α-β))*X. Taking a basis from Module.Free.chooseBasis, Matrix.trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff (no Nonempty or nontriviality hypothesis) gives trace(φ - β) = α - β when A is nontrivial, so trace P = Ring.inverse(α-β)*(α-β) = 1 by hu. (4) P w ∈ A∙w, so P w = c•w for some c. (5) For any v, P v = a•w for some a, and by idempotence P v = P(P v) = a•P w = c•P v, so (1-c)•P = 0. (6) Taking traces, 1 - c = 0, so P w = w, w ∈ M and A∙w ≤ M. With (1) this gives equality. Trivial ring A: V is a subsingleton and both sides are ⊥. No locality is used anywhere, and the hypothesis is not needed for the statement to elaborate (charpoly only needs Free and Finite). It can be deleted independently of h2, or together with it.

The same proof as for [IsLocalRing A] never uses h2. The trace of φ - algebraMap β is read off its characteristic polynomial (X - C(α-β))*X, obtained via LinearMap.charpoly_sub_smul and hφ, using Matrix.trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff through a chosen basis. This gives trace(ordProj φ α β) = 1 without knowing the rank. Then ordProj w = c•w, (1-c)•ordProj = 0 by idempotence (isIdempotentElem_ordProj needs only hφ and hu), so c = 1 and w ∈ range ordProj. Together with range ≤ A∙w from hw, this gives the equality. Trivial ring A: V is a subsingleton and the statement is trivial. Also, for nontrivial A, h2 already follows from hφ via LinearMap.charpoly_natDegree. It can be deleted independently of IsLocalRing, or together with it.
